name: ConditionalWeakTable
description: A ConditionalWeakTable<CwtKey, CwtValue> with N rooted keys; N more keys died and were collected before the dump.
notes: Values are retained only through dependent handles from live keys (ARCHITECTURE.md 6.1). Retained bytes are measured from a CwtKey: the key, its value and the value's 64 byte array. No CwtValue may be reported as a root. The dead-key case still on the heap is LateGarbage.
